```{r}
pacman::p_load(here, cmdstanr, tidyverse, posterior, bayesplot, ggplot2, patchwork)
```

```{r}
draws_list <- readRDS(here("empirical", "empirical_draws.rds"))
```


```{r}

# Helper functions
make_update_df <- function(prior, posterior) {
  bind_rows(
    tibble(value = prior,     type = "Prior"),
    tibble(value = posterior, type = "Posterior")
  )
}

make_update_plot <- function(df, title, xlab) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = value, fill = type, color = type)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Prior" = "blue", "Posterior" = "red")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Prior" = "blue", "Posterior" = "red")) +
    labs(title = title, x = xlab, y = "Density", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

```

```{r}

# Plot for each participant
for (id in names(draws_list)) {
  
  draws <- draws_list[[id]]
  
  # On log scale
  df_logr <- make_update_df(draws$logr_prior, draws$log_r)
  df_logq <- make_update_df(draws$logq_prior, draws$log_q)
  
  # On natural scale
  df_r <- make_update_df(exp(draws$logr_prior), draws$r_value)
  df_q <- make_update_df(exp(draws$logq_prior), draws$q_value)
  
  p_logr <- make_update_plot(df_logr, title = "Log R",    xlab = "log_r")
  p_logq <- make_update_plot(df_logq, title = "Log Q",    xlab = "log_q")
  p_r    <- make_update_plot(df_r,    title = "R (natural scale)", xlab = "r_value")
  p_q    <- make_update_plot(df_q,    title = "Q (natural scale)", xlab = "q_value")
  
  print(
    (p_logr | p_logq) / (p_r | p_q) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = paste("Prior-Posterior Update: Participant", id),
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
      )
  )
}
```

```{r}
all_ids <- names(draws_list)

posterior_df <- map_dfr(all_ids, function(id) {
  draws <- draws_list[[id]]
  tibble(
    id      = id,
    log_r   = draws$log_r,
    log_q   = draws$log_q,
    r_value = draws$r_value,
    q_value = draws$q_value
  )
})

# Color palette — one color per participant
n_ids  <- length(all_ids)
colors <- rainbow(n_ids)
names(colors) <- all_ids

# Log scale plots
p_all_logr <- ggplot(posterior_df, aes(x = log_r, color = id)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "log_r", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

p_all_logq <- ggplot(posterior_df, aes(x = log_q, color = id)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "log_q", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

# Natural scale plots
p_all_r <- ggplot(posterior_df, aes(x = r_value, color = id)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "r_value", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

p_all_q <- ggplot(posterior_df, aes(x = q_value, color = id)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "q_value", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

print(
  (p_all_logr | p_all_logq) / (p_all_r | p_all_q) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Prototype Model - Posterior Density: All Participants",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
    )
)
```

```{r}
all_ids <- names(draws_list)

posterior_df <- map_dfr(all_ids, function(id) {
  draws <- draws_list[[id]]
  tibble(
    id      = id,
    log_r   = draws$log_r,
    log_q   = draws$log_q,
    r_value = draws$r_value,
    q_value = draws$q_value
  )
})

# Prior samples — draw from the prior distributions directly
prior_df <- tibble(
  log_r   = rnorm(4000, mean = -1.6, sd = 0.5),
  log_q   = rnorm(4000, mean = -4.6, sd = 0.5),
  r_value = exp(rnorm(4000, mean = -1.6, sd = 0.5)),
  q_value = exp(rnorm(4000, mean = -4.6, sd = 0.5))
)

# Color palette — one color per participant
n_ids  <- length(all_ids)
colors <- rainbow(n_ids)
names(colors) <- all_ids

# Log scale plots
p_all_logr <- ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = prior_df, aes(x = log_r),
               fill = "grey50", color = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density(data = posterior_df, aes(x = log_r, color = id),
               linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "log_r", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

p_all_logq <- ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = prior_df, aes(x = log_q),
               fill = "grey50", color = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density(data = posterior_df, aes(x = log_q, color = id),
               linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "log_q", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

# Natural scale plots
p_all_r <- ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = prior_df, aes(x = r_value),
               fill = "grey50", color = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density(data = posterior_df, aes(x = r_value, color = id),
               linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "r_value", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

p_all_q <- ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = prior_df, aes(x = q_value),
               fill = "grey50", color = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density(data = posterior_df, aes(x = q_value, color = id),
               linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "q_value", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()

print(
  (p_all_logr | p_all_logq) / (p_all_r | p_all_q) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Prototype Model - Posterior Density: All Participants",
      subtitle = "Grey fill = Prior | Colored lines = Participant posteriors",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
    )
)
```
